verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Refraction at dielectric boundary and Snell's Law n_1*sin(theta_1) = n_2*sin(theta_2) verified. Derived from both Fermat's Principle of least transit time and boundary phase-matching (k_1,parallel = k_2,parallel). Coplanarity of incident ray, interface normal, and refracted ray verified from spatial boundary conditions. Dimensional homogeneity confirmed: Refractive index n = c/v is dimensionless, sin(theta) is dimensionless, products n*sin(theta) are dimensionless. Limiting cases verified: n_1 = n_2 yields theta_1 = theta_2 (no deflection); normal incidence theta_1 = 0 yields theta_2 = 0; n_2 -> infinity yields theta_2 -> 0. Claim traces to curriculum node and formula-opt-snells-law verified.
